faq-a1: Yes. As a student myself, I keep my rates very affordable.
faq-q2: What PC issues do you handle?
faq-a2: All hardware diagnostics: screen, keyboard, battery, cleaning, plus operating system installs.
faq-q3: How long does a website take?
faq-a3: A simple showcase site takes 3 to 5 days. A complex web app takes 1 to 3 weeks.
faq-q4: What kinds of networks can you set up?
faq-a4: Local networks (LAN), secure Wi-Fi, Linux servers (Apache, routing) and GNS3 simulations with Cisco gear.
faq-a5: On site in Porto-Novo for hardware. Fully remote for web and Linux administration.
